from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEntry(BaseModel):
    """A monetary figure mentioned in the judgment (fees, compensation, fines)."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="Description of the amount (e.g., '二审案件受理费', '退赔赃款')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the amount")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., '元')")
    payer_or_payee: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or receives this amount")

class DocumentMatch(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document useful for matching to a known result."""
    # Core Identity
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The unique case identifier mentioned (e.g., (2023) 鄂 1221 刑初 36 号)")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The court issuing the judgment (e.g., '天津市高级人民法院')")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of document/judgment (e.g., '民事二审判决书', '刑事申诉审查裁定书')")
    
    # Parties
    party_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of all parties mentioned (appellants, appellees, defendants, etc.)")
    procedural_role: list[str] = Field(description="Roles of the parties (e.g., '上诉人', '被告人', '申请人')")
    
    # Outcome & Facts
    verdict_summary: str | None = Field(description="A short summary of the court's final ruling (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回再审申请')")
    procedural_history: str | None = Field(description="Mention of previous judgments or proceedings being reviewed")
    
    # Financials
    financial_entries: list[FinancialEntry] = Field(description="List of all monetary values with context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentMatch]
